messages:
emma (product): quick sync — we need to lock down the auth & tenant controls for the new API surface (chat, embeddings, function calling, structured outputs). customers keep asking for per-project keys + smooth rotation. can we outline options and a launch plan?

devon (eng): +1. high-level options i see: 1) org-level keys (current) 2) project-scoped API keys 3) ephemeral/session tokens 4) service-account tokens with fine-grained scopes. each has tradeoffs for routing, telemetry, and SDK UX.

raj (security): from a compliance POV we need: rotation without token reuse, audit trails per-key, explicit permission scoping for function/tool calling, and KMS/HSM integration for private deployments. also mandatory rotation hooks for delegated keys.

li (infra): infra implications: project keys change cache keys for prefix/KV caches and batching buckets — will need migration strategy so we don't blow up tail latency on rollout. also routing layer needs to accept either org or project id header.

olivia (cust-succ): customers are explicit: product teams want per-project billing metrics; security teams want to rotate keys daily for CI systems; platform teams want service accounts that can be nailed down to embeddings-only or model-rerank-only. need clear rollback for them.

deploy-bot: RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2026/auth-project-keys — initial draft posted 2026-03-15.

devon (eng): suggested concrete API/semantic changes: - accept optional header `x-project-id` or `project_id` in body - issue project-scoped API keys in console - token metadata includes `scopes: ["chat","embeddings","tool_call:<name>"]` - add explicit `allowed_functions` claim to prevent tool misuse

emma (product): example header pattern pls (so SDKs can mirror)

devon (eng): code snippet for wire (proto/HTTP):
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
Authorization: Bearer sk_live_...
X-Project-Id: proj_12345
Content-Type: application/json

{ "model": "gpt-neox-20b", "messages": [...] }
```
response when key lacks scope: 403 {"error":"insufficient_scope","required":"tool_call:payments"}

raj (security): also require scope `structured_output` for any responses where we enforce schema validation/execute tool calls. otherwise default to plain text. this reduces accidental privilege escalation.

li (infra): on rotation: plan for dual-accept phase where both old and new keys valid for 10m after rotation, but mark old key as `pending_revoked` so console can show last call list. need to surface token fingerprint in audit logs to support forensics.

olivia (cust-succ): migration ask: for big customers we need a migration guide + a support window where we assist swapping keys and updating SDK usage. also a way to opt for per-project keys without losing historical cost attribution.

devon (eng): rollout phases proposal: 
- alpha: internal + opt-in customers. implement project header, project key issuance, `scopes` claims for basic scopes (chat, embeddings, rerank). console + API backend changes.
- beta: add function/tool scoping, structured_output flag, rotation hooks, SDK updates across langs. monitor latency/50/95/99.
- GA: enforce stricter defaults (no implicit org-scope for tool calls), full docs, deprecation window for legacy org-only keys.

emma (product): launch criteria (what QA + security insists on): 
- audit logs show per-key events for 30 days (prod retention)
- rotation flow tested: no request failures >0.1% during rotation in synthetic tests
- SDKs expose new config (projectId, key) and provide migration helper
- console UX to create project key with scope selection and show last 50 calls

raj (security): add must-have: automated policy to disallow issuing keys with both `admin` and `tool_call:*` unless MFA + SSO enforced. for private deployments must integrate with customer KMS for key storage.

devon (eng): error model we should standardize (so apps can handle): 
- 401 {"error":"invalid_api_key"} 
- 403 {"error":"insufficient_scope","required":"<scope>"} 
- 409 {"error":"project_mismatch","expected":"proj_..."} 
- 429 {"error":"rate_limited","retry_after": n} 

olivia (cust-succ): customers will want retro-billing. we should store project tag on usage events so billing can backfill when they opt-in.

li (infra): telemetry note: tagging requests with project_id changes sampling/aggregation. add mapping table in events pipeline; could be heavy but we can start with 1% sampling for historical remap.

emma (product): ok action items: 
- devon: write up small RFC section on header/schema + sample SDK changes (due EOD Fri)
- raj: list security gating items + policy text for console (due Tue)
- li: performance regression checklist and plan for dual-key acceptance window (due Mon)
- olivia: migration playbook outline and customer comms draft (due Tue)
- ops: rollouts + alpha customer candidates (we'll compile list)

devon (eng): noted. i'll include a minimal compatibility matrix: old org keys continue to work for read-only embeddings and chat (no tool calls) for the beta window; tool calls require scoped keys.

raj (security): last note — store `key_fingerprint`, `issued_by`, `scopes`, `project_id` in audit log. make sure private deployments can forward logs to customer SIEM.

emma (product): thanks all. we'll sync on Mon 10am to review RFC changes.

olivia (cust-succ): looping in 2 customers who asked specifically: Acme Health + Finly — will prep short problem statements.

deploy-bot: RFC updated: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2026/auth-project-keys#v2"
